text: TeachingObjectives The BEcon programme trains students in economic theory, statistical tools, the application of theory to solve practical economic problems in trade, banking, the labour market, and evaluate the regional economic performances of China, Hong Kong and other economies. Students will be furnished with solid theoretical and empirical economic knowledge to analyse and understand human behaviour and social interactions. The programme allows students a high degree of flexibility in planning their future career specialisation. Students may also declare a minor or a second major if they are able to meet the respective requirements. Main Courses Compulsory major: Economics Optional majors: Business Design and Innovation Human Resource Management Quantitative Finance Information Systems Marketing Wealth Management Duration 4 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Economicsby The University of Hong Kong Future Career Given the solid training, graduates of the BEcon programmes are equipped to excel in a wide variety of jobs. Most graduates have secured employment in banks, financial institutions and major corporations. Some have developed careers in government and education, while others have furthered their studies in universities locally and overseas.
